Mar 2026 RS reply matches post; June 2026 IBEF snapshot (sales ~Rs 3,792cr, 39 projects) flagged as single-source; no new imports-avoided figure
CBAM definitive regime in force since 1 Jan 2026; certificates on sale 1 Feb 2027, first declaration due 30 Sep 2027
FY2025-26 buffalo-meat exports ~$5.1bn (+25.6%) per press; no h1 in post, inserted before first h2

FY2025-26 MSE procurement ~49% (Rs 1,15,798cr) but SC/ST share ~1.7% vs 4% sub-target (KNN India, single report)
FY2025-26 full-year exports $863.1bn (+4.6%); goods +0.9%, services +8.7%; gap widened
Adani Ahmedabad blending ~2.2-2.3%; Kawas raised 5%->8%; PNGRB draft blending guidelines due 9-10 Oct 2026 (dates unconfirmed)

Panipat UCO SAF unit missed Dec 2025; reported slipped to H2 2026 (Argus via summary); no production start found
SEBI asked MCA (late Aug 2026) to add fractional shares to pending Companies Amendment Bill; nothing enacted
UP domestic GST Sep 2026 Rs 8,882cr, +18% y/y (released 1 Oct 2026)
